counted_by: Three mechanisms, all running today. (1) EVIDENCE CENSUS: one unconditional greppable line from gate.py carrying current/stale/undated/unverifiable counts plus the clone depth and head it was taken at, written to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY on every deploy-gate run, red or green. (2) pytest's own skip total in test-backend: a shallow checkout asserts unverifiable and then skips, so the undetermined population appears as a number instead of inside a green tick (verified: 3 skipped at base under depth 1, 2 skipped on this branch under depth 0). (3) gate.py --evidence-check REFUSES with exit 2 in a shallow checkout, so no shallow environment can emit a green for this determination at all.
